reviews.title: excellent ram for getting into DDR5
reviews.comment:
DDR5 at this point in time, 02-26-2023, is still rather expensive compared to DDR4.  If you have a motherboard that requires DDR5, this is an excellent kit to get you started until the prices for more performant DDR5 drops down to poverty levels.  That being said, the kit does perform well in games if you're a casual player like myself, but if you love to chase the highest FPS, the kit may only serve as a stop-gap in your situation until, again, more performant stuff drops in price.
I do specifically like the look of bare RAM modules as opposed to modules with heatsinks strapped on, gives a more computery look that I really enjoy.  That being said, i will likely upgrade in the future, and these DIMMs will perform well as test DIMMs for test benches, but it will be a hard pressed decision, as there really is no reason to upgrade unless you're a professional gamer.  Most people will do just fine on these types of low cost DIMMs while still looking amazing in the system.
I have really come to trust team group as my source for RAM and SSD product source, nearly all my PCs use team group products for both the categories and they all run flawlessly.

reviews.author: Jacob

reviews.title: TEAMGROUP Elite DDR5 64GB Kit
reviews.comment:
It’s RAM. It works. The TEAMGROUP Elite DDR5 64GB kit doesn’t try to be anything it’s not, and I appreciate that.
It’s DDR5, so yeah, it’s fast. If you’re upgrading from DDR4, you’ll notice the difference. 64GB is more than enough for multitasking or gaming, and it just does what it’s supposed to do without any weird issues.
Installation is simple. It slots into the motherboard like it should, and once it’s in, you’re good. No drama, no troubleshooting.
The design is basic, no RGB or anything fancy, but honestly, who cares? It’s memory. If you want lights, buy a strip.
